# LeonidaTracker

> A free, unofficial GTA 6 companion: a 100% tracker that saves in your browser, a searchable cheats database, completion calculators and original guides.

Unofficial fan resource for Grand Theft Auto VI. Cheat codes are listed only after confirmation by multiple independent sources.

## Tools
- [100% Tracker](https://theleonidatracker.com/tracker/): checklist and counters for missions, collectibles and cheat challenges
- [Cheats Database](https://theleonidatracker.com/cheats/): all 61 cheats, 18 verified codes, unlock requirements
- [Calculators](https://theleonidatracker.com/calculators/): cheat unlock planner, 100% gap check, play-time estimator
